column1: # tests/gate-coverage-exempt.tsv — explicit skip-list for tests/test-*.sh files that must NOT run
# in the authoritative merge gate (tests/herd.bats + scripts/ci/run-suite.sh).
# Under HERD-295 dynamic discovery, tests/herd.bats globs tests/test-*.sh and runs each one; a file
# listed here is SKIPPED by discovery (and by the CI curated runner). The gate-coverage drift guard
# (scripts/herd/gate-coverage-lint.sh) honors this list and never reds an exempt file.
# Every row is a bare test filename (no path, no inline comment; whole-line match).
# Convention: add a row here ONLY when there is a known reason the test cannot run in the hermetic
# gate (e.g. flaky on CI, depends on live env). A NEW hermetic test needs no edit here OR in
# herd.bats — discovery picks it up automatically; only list it if it must be kept OUT.
# HERD-437 (2026-07-30): audited every row this file carried from the HERD-292 bulk population
# (179 rows, no per-row reason ever recorded). Each was actually EXECUTED under a sandboxed HOME +
# pre-seeded PROJECT_ROOT/WORKTREES_DIR (closing the HERD-436 real-ledger-leak class) to confirm a
# real pass before un-exempting it. 168 passed cleanly and are wired in (removed from this file —
# discovery now covers them). test-sandbox-concurrency.sh was ALSO removed: it turned out to
# already be wired via a bespoke @test block in tests/herd.bats (HERD-331, 2026-07-12) and this row
# had gone stale/redundant. The 10 rows below are the ones that did NOT cleanly pass — each has its
# own findings filed via `herd note` (journal) for a follow-up item; see the HERD-437 PR body for
# the full per-test evidence and the exact failing assertion. Do not remove one of these without
# re-running it and seeing a real, reproducible pass first.
